🚀 anti-slop | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To enhance the quality and originality of AI-generated code, UI, and copy by filtering out common AI-generated 'slop'.
✨ Key Features: • Filters generic AI-generated UI designs • Filters filler AI-generated copy • Filters AI-shaped code • Acts as a filter, not a style guide • Complements design direction (e.g., DESIGN.md)
📖 Summary: Anti Slop provides a set of rules designed to filter out generic, uninspired content generated by AI coding agents. It acts as a pre-processing layer to ensure that AI-generated UI, copy, and code are not only functional but also avoid common AI pitfalls like filler text, fake data, and overly generic design elements. The goal is to produce cleaner, more directed, and less 'slop-filled' output from AI coding tools.
